```{r message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Reading and cleaning the subways dataset

```{r}
subways_df = 
  read_csv("data/NYC_Transit_Subway_Entrance_And_Exit_Data.csv") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    entry = case_match(
      entry,
      "YES" ~ TRUE,
      "NO" ~ FALSE
    )
  )
```
